name: Иконки снаряжения сеткой — 9 слотов × 7 редкостей = 63 шаблона, три листа 7×3 (слово автора 30.09.2026: «а после тогда в таком же стиле сделай сетку для духовных талисманов, снаряжений»). Манера — как у иконок способностей: style и negative — из spell-icons-fire.json

plan.Язык иконки: строка листа — один слот, столбец — редкость: предмет узнаётся по силуэту, а редкость растёт слева направо — материал, оковка, свет изнутри. Цвет света снизу и камня — цвет редкости (ADR-0027): обычная белая, редкая жёлтая, уникальная бирюзовая, эпическая фиолетовая, древняя красная, первородная оранжевая, вневременная зелёная
plan.Листы: eq-armor-top — шлем, доспех, перчатки; eq-armor-low — поножи, сапоги, оружие; eq-jewel — щит, кольцо, амулет. 21:9 = 7:3, клетка квадратная
plan.Прежние значки слотов: jobs/equipment.json — один нейтральный значок на слот с прозрачным фоном; остаются запасными, иконка шаблона их заменяет

notes: cells — [шаблон EN_EQUIPMENT.templates «слот.редкость», имя файла]; grid — [столбцы, строки]
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold and warm light contrast. Dust motes and grains of sand float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images, but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no captions, titles or labels under, over or inside the icons, no real-world alphabets, no runes or marks that look like writing, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no frames or borders drawn inside the cells. No pentagrams, no occult signs. No magenta or pink anywhere inside the icons: magenta appears only in the gutters.

equip-icons.frame:
Format: a sheet of square equipment icons for a mobile RPG, painted together as one consistent set. The icons stand in a precise grid of equal square cells; the number of columns and rows and the item in every row are listed below, row by row from the top, each row from left to right. Between the cells run narrow straight gutters of flat, uniform pure magenta (#FF00FF), and the same magenta gutter runs around the outside of the whole grid. All gutters have the same width, all cells have the same size, and nothing crosses a gutter. Every cell is its own complete square painting filled from edge to edge — the game puts its own frame on top. Every cell shows one piece of equipment, empty and standing alone — nobody wears or holds it — centered, about two thirds of the cell, seen straight on or in a clear three-quarter view, with a bold silhouette that stays readable at 48 px, on a dark near-black stone background with faint cracks and a darker vignette toward the edges of the cell. Light rises from below; crisp rim light on the edges of the item; a few dust motes in the light. Painted exactly like the ability icons of this game: loose, confident painterly brush strokes, soft painted edges and deep shadows — no black outlines, no flat sticker look. No ornaments that look like letters, runes or writing. Each row is one kind of item shown in seven rarities, from left to right, and the item grows richer with every step — in material, in fittings and in the light inside it — while its kind, its view and its basic silhouette stay the same, so the row reads as one item growing in rarity:
1. common — plain, worn dark iron and scuffed leather, no ornament, no gems, no inner light; cold pale white light (#E6E8EA) from below.
2. rare — sound polished steel with brass rivets and a thin edging of gold; one small yellow gem (#F0CC4F) glows faintly; warm yellow light from below.
3. unique — fine blued steel with thin silver inlay; one turquoise gem (#1FB8D0) glows softly; turquoise light from below.
4. epic — dark steel with gold filigree edging and a violet crystal (#A986EE) glowing from within; thin violet light seeps from its seams; violet light from below.
5. ancient — heavy ancient metal darkened by ages, with gold fittings; a red crystal (#E85A4E) with a swirl of flame inside it; thin red cracks glow from within; red light from below.
6. primordial — black metal and old gold of a primordial make; bright orange fire (#EB9D40) burns inside its crystal and seams like molten metal; orange light from below.
7. timeless — the richest of all: dark metal and bright gold with ornate fittings; a large green crystal (#5FD67A) radiating light; green energy glows from within every seam; green light from below.
All items share the same brushwork, lighting and level of detail, so they read as one set.

jobs.title: Шлем, доспех, перчатки — по семь редкостей, сеткой 7×3
jobs.source: design/ui/equipment.js (EN_EQUIPMENT.templates: слот.редкость), docs/content/снаряжение.md; цвета редкостей — ADR-0027
jobs.subject:
The grid: exactly 7 columns and 3 rows, 21 icons. The columns are the seven rarities, from common on the left to timeless on the right.

Row 1 — a helmet: an open-faced helmet in a three-quarter view turned slightly to the right, a rounded dome with one nose guard down the front and a short curtain of mail at the back of the neck; the common one is a plain riveted iron cap, the higher ones gain a crest, cheek guards, gold trim and a glowing crystal on the brow.

Row 2 — body armour: a breastplate with broad rounded shoulder plates, seen straight on, empty; the common one is plain dented iron over leather, the higher ones gain layered plates, gold edging, ornamental grooves and a glowing crystal in the middle of the chest.

Row 3 — a gauntlet: one armoured glove standing upright, seen from the back of the hand, an open hand with straight fingers slightly spread — never a fist; the common one is plain leather with a few iron plates, the higher ones gain articulated plates, gold edging, small claws at the fingertips and a glowing crystal on the back of the hand.

jobs.subject:
The grid: exactly 7 columns and 3 rows, 21 icons. The columns are the seven rarities, from common on the left to timeless on the right.

Row 1 — leg armour: a pair of plate leggings seen straight on, standing upright like a pair of trousers joined at a belt, two legs side by side with a narrow gap, ending above the ankles — no boots; the common one is plain leather with iron knee caps, the higher ones gain full plates, gold rims and glowing crystals on the knees.

Row 2 — boots: a pair of heavy boots standing side by side in a three-quarter view, toes pointing to the lower right; the common one is worn leather with iron toe caps, the higher ones gain plates, gold buckles, spurs and glowing crystals at the ankles.

Row 3 — a weapon: a longsword set diagonally, its hilt at the lower left and its point at the upper right; the common one is a plain iron blade with a leather grip, the higher ones gain a finer blade, an ornate gold crossguard, a pommel crystal and light along the groove of the blade.

jobs.subject:
The grid: exactly 7 columns and 3 rows, 21 icons. The columns are the seven rarities, from common on the left to timeless on the right.

Row 1 — a shield: a round shield seen straight on, with a raised boss in the middle; the common one is weathered wooden planks with a dark iron rim, the higher ones gain metal facing, gold rims, ornament and a glowing crystal as the boss.

Row 2 — a ring: a heavy ring standing upright in a three-quarter view, so that both its thick round band and its top are clearly visible, the hole of the band open; the common one is a plain iron band with a dull grey stone, the higher ones gain silver and gold, filigree and a larger glowing crystal of their colour.

Row 3 — an amulet: an oval pendant hanging on a short chain that rises to a loop at the top; the common one is a plain iron disc on a leather cord, the higher ones gain silver and gold settings, filigree and a larger glowing crystal of their colour.
